description:
List law records for one jurisdiction and area of law.

    Use this when you want jurisdiction-scoped records. Omitting jurisdiction returns science claims.
    Returns record id, status, evidence strength, a shortened excerpt, jurisdiction, and area of law.
    Example: query_law(jurisdiction="DE", area_of_law="data-protection", query="consent", limit=5).
    Example: query_law(query="transformer", limit=5).

area_of_law.description: Area of law slug. Example: data-protection.
area_of_law.title: Area Of Law

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code. Example: DE. Omit it to search science.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

query.description: Text matched against the statement and its excerpt. Example: consent.
query.title: Query

name: query_law

LawRecordHit.description: One science or law record. List fields stay short, plus the law keys.
LawRecordHit.title: LawRecordHit

outputSchema.description: Law records for a jurisdiction, or science claims when jurisdiction is omitted.
outputSchema.title: LawRecordsResult
